MasulloGRH.rationalHeckeXi_eq_completed (τ : ℝ) (s : ℂ) (h0 : s + I * ↑τ ≠ 0) (h1 : s + I * ↑τ ≠ 1) :
  rationalHeckeXi τ s = (s + I * ↑τ) * (s + I * ↑τ - 1) * rationalHeckeCompleted τ s
'MasulloGRH.rationalHeckeXi_eq_completed' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.rationalHeckeXi_zero_iff (τ : ℝ) (s : ℂ) (h0 : s + I * ↑τ ≠ 0) (h1 : s + I * ↑τ ≠ 1) :
  rationalHeckeXi τ s = 0 ↔ rationalHeckeCompleted τ s = 0
'MasulloGRH.rationalHeckeXi_zero_iff' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

MasulloGRH.rationalHeckeDivisor_genuine (τ : ℝ) (d : RationalHeckeDivisor τ) :
  0 < (↑d.fst).re ∧
    (↑d.fst).re < 1 ∧
      rationalHeckeFinite τ ↑d.fst = 0 ∧
        rationalHeckeMultiplicity τ ↑d.fst = analyticOrderNatAt (rationalHeckeFinite τ) ↑d.fst

MasulloGRH.unshiftedClearing_spurious_zero (τ : ℝ) (hτ : τ ≠ 0) :
